jpyc_ex.title: Issue / redeem JPYC
jpyc_ex.intro: Swapping yen for JPYC is done on JPYC EX, the official service run by JPYC Inc. This page walks you through both directions.
jpyc_ex.issue_sub: Send yen by bank transfer and JPYC arrives in your registered wallet.
jpyc_ex.issue_step1: Create a JPYC EX account, then finish identity verification and register a bank account
jpyc_ex.issue_step2: Register the wallet address (and chain) that should receive JPYC on JPYC EX — you can use the address below
jpyc_ex.issue_step3: Reserve an issuance on JPYC EX and make the bank transfer to the account shown
jpyc_ex.issue_step4: Once the deposit is confirmed, JPYC is issued to your registered address. Check your balance on Home
jpyc_ex.redeem_sub: Reserve a redemption on JPYC EX, send the JPYC, and yen is paid to your registered bank account.
jpyc_ex.redeem_step1: Reserve a redemption on JPYC EX (chain, sending address, amount)
jpyc_ex.redeem_step2: Send JPYC to the address shown after you reserve (use "Send JPYC" below)
jpyc_ex.redeem_step3: Send exactly the reserved amount, from your registered address, before the deadline
jpyc_ex.redeem_step4: Once the transfer is confirmed, yen is paid to your registered bank account
jpyc_ex.redeem_caution: Sending requires gas (the chain's fee currency). Have some ready beforehand.
jpyc_ex.note: Review, extra verification, and acceptance/confirmation of requests are handled by JPYC Inc. Check JPYC EX for the latest minimums, limits, and fees.
